blocks.html: The stairway or ramp shaft shall be provided with a dampered relief opening and supplied with sufficient air to maintain a minimum positive pressure of 0.10 inch of water (24.9 Pa) in the shaft relative to the vestibule with all doors closed. The system shall maintain a maximum of 0.35 inch of water (87.2 Pa) in the shaft relative to the building measured with all stairway doors closed under maximum anticipated stack pressures.
